summary: Iter 22 — Tested CEO Net-Worth PDF export, Dashboard refactor, and AXC-NNNNN customer lookup fix. 9/9 backend pytest cases PASSED. Frontend Dashboard renders all 4 KPI rows (Revenue / Obligations / Treasury / Posture) and the Export Net Worth PDF button works end-to-end — clicked, downloaded Axistra-Net-Worth-20260601.pdf (283,940 bytes, %PDF magic verified).

issues: Console warning from recharts: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' — likely the Sales Trend ResponsiveContainer renders before its parent has layout. Non-blocking but worth adding minWidth/minHeight or fixed height fallback.

critical_code_review_comments: dashboard.service.ts kpis() and netWorth() compute payroll-due differently. UI dashboard payroll-due card shows 'USD 0.00 / No pending run' while net-worth() reports 35000 AED outstanding for the May draft run. Both code paths technically resolve draft runs but the displayed amount differs from the PDF — consider unifying both views around a single helper to avoid CEO confusion.

dashboard.service.ts file is 504 lines and the netWorth() method alone is ~150 lines. Consider extracting netWorth and PDF rendering helpers into a separate NetWorthService for SRP and easier testing.
renderNetWorthPdf uses Puppeteer — confirm Puppeteer/Chromium is included in the production Docker image; PDF generation will silently fail in prod otherwise.

customers.service.findCustomer() does a UUID regex check first; good. But the same helper should be used in any other place that resolves customer id (recharges, payroll, contracts) — audit for consistency so AXC-NNNNN is accepted everywhere users expect.
seed_data_creation: PATCH test mutates the AXC-00001 customer's notes field to 'TEST_iter22_patch_via_code'. Not destructive but main agent may want to reset notes if it cares.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter22 pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_iter22_dashboard_customers.py covers net-worth JSON + PDF + customer lookup by AXC-code/UUID + PATCH-by-code. Dashboard.jsx now lean (~175 lines) and uses KpiRows/Atoms — confirmed renders correctly with PDF download working via data-testid='dashboard-export-net-worth-btn'. 2FA already enrolled on admin account in current environment, so login flow goes straight to /dashboard.
rca of the issue: Bug fix verified: customers.service.findCustomer() now does a UUID regex check before calling findOne(); for AXC-NNNNN it falls through to a customer_code lookup. Previously, passing a non-UUID directly to TypeORM where: {id: 'AXC-99999'} caused Postgres to throw 'invalid input syntax for type uuid' which surfaced as a generic 500. Confirmed: AXC-99999 → 404, AXC-00001 → 200, UUID → 200, PATCH AXC-00001 persists.
